description: Update a vendor by id. Every field is preserve-on-omit — omitting a field keeps the vendor's current value (it is NOT cleared). Changing name/code/tax/bank re-checks uniqueness. customFields merges per key (see list_custom_fields with entity=businessPartner): omitted keys keep their value, an explicit null clears one, and an unknown fieldName fails the whole call at preview. Only existing vendors are targetable (a non-vendor partner id returns NOT_FOUND). Requires an operator (unpinned) org token.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

input.description: Fields to change; omitted fields keep their current value.

bankAccountNumber.description: New bank account number; omit to keep. Must stay unique within the tenant.

code.description: New unique code; omit to keep.

contactName.description: New contact person name; omit to keep.

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by fieldName (see list_custom_fields, entity=businessPartner — vendors and customers share the businessPartner entity). Merged per key: omitted keys keep their current value, an explicit null clears one. list fields take an option id or name; multilist an array of them. An unknown fieldName fails validation.

defaultLeadTimeDays.description: New default lead time in days (0-365); omit to keep.

email.description: New contact email; omit to keep.

name.description: New name; omit to keep. Must stay unique within the tenant.

paymentTermsDays.description: New payment terms in days (0-365; 30 = "Net 30"); omit to keep.

phoneNumber.description: New contact phone number; omit to keep.

taxNumber.description: New tax/registration number; omit to keep. Must stay unique within the tenant.

vatIdNumber.description: New VAT identification number; omit to keep.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: update_supplier
title: Update Vendor
